task_definitions.title: Environment Configuration Setup
task_definitions.description: Ensure proper environment configuration with validation for required variables (NOTION_API_KEY, NOTION_DATABASE_ID). Create .env.example template file with documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Environment variables are validated on startup
Meaningful error messages for missing configuration

task_definitions.title: Input Validation for Task Operations
task_definitions.description: Add validation for createTask and updateTask functions to ensure required fields are provided and properly formatted before API calls.
acceptance_criteria: Status validation (valid status name) in updateTask
Throw descriptive errors for invalid inputs

task_definitions.title: Task Retrieval Functionality
task_definitions.description: Implement function to query and retrieve tasks from the Notion database with filtering capabilities (by status, assignee, etc.).

task_definitions.title: Error Handling Enhancement
task_definitions.description: Improve error handling with retry logic for transient failures, better error messages, and structured error responses.
acceptance_criteria: Retry logic for rate limits (exponential backoff)
Distinguish between retriable and non-retriable errors
Structured error responses with error codes

task_definitions.title: Task Deletion Functionality
task_definitions.description: Implement function to archive or delete tasks from the Notion database (Notion uses archiving rather than hard deletion).

task_definitions.title: Bulk Operations Support
task_definitions.description: Add functionality to create, update, or delete multiple tasks in a single operation with proper error handling for partial failures.
acceptance_criteria: createTasksBulk() handles array of task objects
Returns results with success/failure status for each item

task_definitions.title: Comprehensive Test Suite
task_definitions.description: Develop unit and integration tests for all task operations with mocked Notion API responses.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for all exported functions

task_definitions.title: Documentation Enhancement
task_definitions.description: Create comprehensive documentation including setup instructions, API reference, usage examples, and troubleshooting guide.
acceptance_criteria: All functions documented with JSDoc comments

task_definitions.title: CLI Interface Implementation
task_definitions.description: Add command-line interface to enable task operations from terminal without modifying code (optional enhancement).
acceptance_criteria: Support CLI commands: create, update, list, delete

task_definitions.title: Logging and Monitoring Enhancement
task_definitions.description: Implement structured logging with different log levels and optional file-based logging for production use.
acceptance_criteria: Support log levels: debug, info, warn, error
